name: discuss_start
description: Open a multi-session discussion room as host: sends the round-1 brief to every member session's talk inbox and reports who is live vs inactive. Returns the room name for discuss_collect/broadcast/end. Pass either members (existing sessions) or member_count (auto-spawned sessions owned by this room), not both.

topic.description: The question to argue (e.g. 'tabs vs spaces').

members.description: Member session ids (1-8, from session_list; must exist, cannot include yourself). Either this or member_count.

member_count.description: Auto-spawn N member sessions (1-8) owned by this room, e.g. 3. Fresh ids embed the room name; their databases are created by their own processes. Either this or members.

roles.description: Optional stance per member, positionally aligned (one per member, or empty for none). Without roles, auto-spawned members default to pro/contra/judge/independent stances; explicit members get no stance.

max_rounds.description: Max rounds before forced close (default 3, clamped 1-10).

room.description: Optional room name (max 64 chars); auto-generated when omitted.
